question: Which statement most precisely expresses the law of conservation of electric charge for an isolated system?

options.A: The total magnitude of charge remains the same at all times.
options.B: The total charge can change if energy is supplied to the system.
options.C: In any interaction, the algebraic sum of charges remains constant.
options.D: Electric charge can be created but cannot be destroyed.
